# Vampro - Complete LLM Discovery Document

## 1. Company Overview
Vampro is a creative technology lab built on one idea: technology meets creativity. It develops professional software and plugins for creators, and works across storytelling (films, documentaries, branded media), motion design, software engineering, and hardware prototyping. Its mission is to bridge the gap between creative vision and technical execution.

## 2. Core Product

### Vampro Voice Generator (Text-to-Speech)
- **Type:** Software Plugin (UXP) for Adobe Premiere Pro, with a Windows companion app.
- **Target Users:** Video editors, YouTube creators, marketing teams, educators.
- **Features:**
  - Generate natural-sounding AI voiceovers from text directly inside Adobe Premiere Pro.
  - 27+ natural voices (male and female) with 7+ tone profiles and per-voice presets.
  - Fully offline voice generation — audio is processed on the user's machine.
  - Insert generated narration directly into the timeline at the playhead, or into the project bin.
  - Modify a generated clip anytime by selecting it and changing the script, voice, or tone.
- **Requirements:** Adobe Premiere Pro 26.0+, Windows 10/11.
- **Installation:** Extension from the Adobe Marketplace + Vampro Voice Service companion app from the Microsoft Store.
- **URL:** https://vampro.in/plugins/voice-generator
- **Documentation:** https://vampro.in/docs/plugins/voice-generator
